data.title: About DSMLC
data.subtitle: Learn more about the Data Science and Machine Learning Club at the University of Calgary.

data.text: The Data Science and Machine Learning Club (DSMLC) at the University of Calgary is a student-led initiative providing a platform for students to engage with data science and machine learning concepts. We create learning opportunities for students across all disciplines through workshops, competitions, and networking events, equipping them with the skills necessary for their future careers in these rapidly growing fields.

Our mission is to foster a thriving community where students from all backgrounds can explore and learn about data science and machine learning. Through hands-on educational experiences, we bridge the gap between theory and practice, enabling students to apply their knowledge to real-world problems.

We aim to become a respected leader within the data science and machine learning communities in Calgary, creating a space where students can innovate, collaborate, and grow. We strive to make data science accessible to all students, regardless of their academic background, and to extend our reach beyond the University of Calgary.

DSMLC organizes a wide range of activities that enrich the educational experience of students and promote professional growth. These initiatives fall into three primary categories: Skills Workshops, Networking Events, and Competitions.
Our workshops equip students with essential data science and machine learning skills, with content designed for all experience levels.

data.text: We host events that connect students with professionals from industry and academia, providing invaluable networking opportunities.
An event featuring students and professors sharing their experiences with data science research, offering tips on securing research positions and insight into ongoing projects.
An event dedicated to connecting students with industry professionals, providing insights into career opportunities and developments in data science and machine learning industries.

data.text: The Visionary Lab connects students with real-world data science experience through projects from local businesses and nonprofits. By tackling these challenges, students gain practical skills and resume-worthy experiences, while partner organizations benefit from innovative, data-driven solutions at no cost. The Visionary Lab bridges the gap between academics and application.
